decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - A reduction of the extension's height and depth (adjoining 5 Ringway) may help this extension receive a favourable recommendation. The extension would need to be modified into an 'L' shape to accommodate the reduction in depth alongside 5 Ringway.

Condition : 3 - Please ensure that plans submitted accurately reflect the extension, or the proposed extensions (should amendments to the existing extension be proposed and submitted to the Council). The plans submitted do not show the true height of the extension.

Condition : 4 - The applicant is advised that the site is located within 250m of a former landfill. As such a site investigation should normally be undertaken to identify the extent of contamination, with results provided to the Local Planning Authority and works to protect occupiers of the building undertaken if necessary.
description: Retention of single storey rear extension to house.
